mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% MoM does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase MoM
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or UNRATE < 3.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a supply-side contraction and weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or joint decrease in INDPRO and increase in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
